thread:
sarah: When Private is on-prem, do we allow any telemetry component to read billing tokens or model KMS keys? SRE wants cost tracing but Legal/InfoSec flagged risk. Need clear boundary in the runtime manifest.

ajay: Strong no on raw tokens. Proposal: split correlation into two modes: realtime-bridge (customer-authorized, requires KMS grant) and async-bucket (default). The runtime manifest should declare 'telemetry_mode' and 'allowed_endpoints'.

max: Prototype manifest example: 
```json
{
  "manifest_version": "v1",
  "telemetry": {
    "mode": "async",
    "forward_to": [],
    "secret_forwarding": false
  }
}
```

olivia: Policy: async-only by default. If customer requests realtime-bridge, require an explicit signed consent, dedicated KMS grant with envelope encryption, and an on-prem audit record that we store only on customer side.

sarah: Operationally, how do we join events? Idea: emit correlation token = base64(HMAC_SHA256(tenant_key, trace_id || date)). Hosted services never see tenant_key. Gateway can accept tokens and return a pseudonymized billing id.

nate: Legal: any flow that moves identifiable billing data off-prem needs contract language. Also require retention caps.

max: Two join patterns:
- realtime: telemetry-gateway does on-the-fly mapping, needs mTLS, ACLs, SLA.
- async: runtime uploads encrypted logs to customer-owned bucket; hosted billing runs batch job with customer's cooperation (customer provides ephemeral mapping keys).

ajay: Async avoids runtime touching hosted services. Realtime useful for low-latency cost debugging but costs complexity. Recommend 'async' default and 'realtime' opt-in behind compliance review.

olivia: Agree. Add manifest fields: 'telemetry.mode', 'telemetry.realtime_requirements' (list), and 'audit.local_only'. Also require a 'consent_uri' when realtime=true.

sarah: OK — actionables: max to open RFC with sample manifest, threat model, gateway auth spec; ajay to sketch batch join job; olivia/nate to propose consent and contract text. Please include acceptance tests for Private GA (no secret leakage).

deploy-bot: New draft RFC: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/1770029999-telemetry-join-patterns - link shared.

sarah: Thanks all. I'll coordinate follow-ups in RFC thread. Please flag any concerns in comments within 48h. :pray:
